content.text: Start with a "camping out" approach - sit beside Milo's bed until he's drowsy, then move your chair a little closer to the door each night over one to two weeks. At 5 a kid this age does best with a consistent bedtime routine and a small comfort object to anchor the new setup. The transition usually clicks within two to three weeks once the routine is steady.
